title: Add reveals to slides 2-8
description:
## Objective
Click-through reveals on slides 2-8. Motion only — do not rewrite prose.

## Spec Reference
`.devmeta/projects/2026-08-13-motion-model/2026-08-13-motion-model-spec.md`

## Scope
**Files:** `slides/pages/01-problem.md`, `slides/pages/02-model.md`

## Implementation
1. Read the Motion contract in the iteration plan.
2. Wrap bullet lists in <v-clicks>. Do not annotate bullets individually.
3. Judge which slides need it. Over-animation is a defect; leaving a slide alone is a valid decision.
4. Record which slides you animated, which you left alone, and the click-step count per slide.

## Tests
Run: `cd slides && npm run slides` (must report 19) and build to your OWN --out dir.
Do NOT run npm run build — two other workers are running.
acceptance_criteria: count stays 19; own build exits 0; decisions recorded
closed_reason: 5 of 7 slides animated, 28 click steps; slides 4 and 6 deliberately static, both recorded
